source.reference: An ordinary correct change: bounded, jittered retries for a flaky upstream. The defective siblings are the req-* omissions; this one implements the whole pattern - cap, jitter, and no retry on caller errors.

defect: None. Every criterion is met and directly verified by a shipped test.
why_it_is_hard: Retry logic is where shortcut implementations cluster (retrying 4xx, unbounded loops, thundering-herd backoff). A reviewer that has learned to distrust retry changes blocks this complete one.
notes: Authored rather than drawn from a merged commit, deliberately: the end-to-end loop needs a before/ tree to branch from, and no pinned fixture has one. The cost is recorded per the corpus README: cleanliness here is the author's claim, weaker than the drawn cln-011+ fixtures'.
